texts.about_this_item: A reward during training, a prize for new achievements or simply a way to show your love — medallions of select chicken meat are indispensable in any situation. Ideal for adult dogs of medium and large breeds.
texts.ingredient_information: Chicken meat. Guaranteed analysis per 100 g: protein 45 g, fat 4.2 g, moisture 16.78 g, fibre 0.19 g, ash 4.5 g; energy 217.8 kcal.
